metas.name: A Merry Scottish Christmas
metas.description: When estranged siblings Lindsay and Brad travel to Scotland at Christmas to reunite with their mother Jo, a big family secret is revealed.

metas.name: A Million Miles Away
metas.description: The life of engineer and former NASA astronaut José M. Hernández, the first migrant farmworker to go to space.

metas.name: A Neighbors Vendetta
metas.description: After her boss-turned-secret lover is found dead, architect Sonja vows to give her marriage another chance. She and her husband decide to make a fresh start and rent a remote cabin. But when an unexpected neighbor appears at their door, they soon discover that she’s linked to Sonja’s adulterous past and is intent on taking “an eye for an eye.”

metas.name: A Not So Royal Christmas
metas.description: When tabloid journalist Charlotte requests an interview with a famously private Count — not knowing he fled town years ago — the royal family convinces their groundskeeper to pose as him.

metas.name: A Perfect Christmas Pairing
metas.description: Winter sets in as top chef Grace Cooke, at the helm of a high-end restaurant, rakes in rave reviews due to her gastro-scientific approach to cuisine. She’s close to a Michelin star when a bad review from a top critic rocks her world. With her boss’ blessing, she takes time off to see her family at their winery B&B over Christmas. There, she connects with worldly travel writer Asher St. James, and sparks fly with family traditions as Asher helps her reconnect with her roots.

metas.name: A Really Haunted Loud House
metas.description: Lincoln and his best friend, Clyde, struggle to decide whether to participate in the Loud family Spooktacular, attend their friend, Xander's, party, or go trick-or-treating on Halloween.

metas.name: A Royal Christmas Holiday
metas.description: In search of her big break, a reporter arranges a Christmas interview with a European Prince visiting the states. Will the reporter’s big story become her love story?

metas.name: A Royal Date For Christmas
metas.description: Bella Sparks, owner of Bella’s Boutique, takes on a demanding new client named Stefan, who needs to be outfitted for a week of high-stakes meetings and events after his luggage goes missing. Imagine Bella’s reaction when she accidentally discovers Stefan is actually Stefan William Francis Brown, the Duke of Tangford.

metas.name: A Royal Makeover
metas.description: When all-American Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. To prepare him for his royal duties, King Felipe hires royal expert Angelica to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

metas.name: A Royal Recipe For Love
metas.description: When Emma, an up-and-coming baker in New York City, is hired to bake for the King and Queen of Sanovia’s anniversary party, she is convinced a good job will lead to her landing a cookbook deal.

metas.name: A Safari Romance
metas.description: A wildlife biologist working on fostering the protection of wildlife in Africa is forced to team up with a theme park designer who wants to create an over-the-top safari attraction

metas.name: A Season For Family
metas.description: While Maddie’s adopted son wants to meet his brother Cody, who was adopted into another family, Cody’s father, isn’t ready.

metas.name: A Still Small Voice
metas.description: An aspiring hospital chaplain begins a yearlong residency in spiritual care, only to discover that to successfully tend to her patients, she must look deep within herself.

metas.name: A Taste Of Sin
metas.description: Faith, forgiveness, redemption and hope. Two pastors, poles apart, navigate their temptations -- one tempted by money, and the other by desire.

metas.name: A Thousand And One
metas.description: Struggling but unapologetically living on her own terms, Inez is moving from shelter to shelter in mid-1990s New York City. With her 6-year-old son Terry in foster care and unable to leave him again, she kidnaps him so they can build their life together. As the years go by, their family grows and Terry becomes a smart yet quiet teenager, but the secret that has defined their lives threatens to destroy the home they have so improbably built.

metas.name: A Tribe Called Judah
metas.description: With the help of their mother, the Judah boys plan to rob a small mall. But when they arrive, they're met by real armed robbers.

metas.name: A Very Demi Holiday Special
metas.description: A heartwarming, captivating special featuring music and plenty of out-of-this-world surprises, A VERY DEMI HOLIDAY SPECIAL will fill your home and heart with a very Demi twist on the festive spirit. Demi has invited some of her friends to help her celebrate the holidays.

metas.name: A Vineyard Christmas
metas.description: Heather Marques, host of Tannin TV’s popular show: Read Between the Vines, is determined to create the perfect Christmas episode by featuring a unique winery from her hometown in Washington State the specialists in Ice Wine. The only thing standing in her way? Rudy Knobloch, the attractive, stubborn owner of the winery.

metas.name: A Wandering Path
metas.description: Adam Bartlett started Gilead Media record label in 2005. His first releases were small runs of LPs and CDs, but fast forward to the present, he now he runs a celebrated underground label that is renowned internationally for putting out black metal, doom, and noise rock releases of well-known bands. He and his partner Dave Adelson from the record label, 20 Buck Spin, put on Migration Fest every two years where heavy music fans from around the world come together to perform, hang out, and create strong personal bonds. Through live performances, interviews, and BTS footage, we meet musicians, learn how they write and perform music as a means to cope with issues such as sexual abuse, depression, childhood indoctrination of Christianity, and grief from loss of loved ones. Features appearance from members of Thou, Neurosis, Enslaved, Panopticon, Emma Ruth Rundle, Yellow Eyes, Couch Slut, Blood Incantation, Krallice, Mizmor, Weigedood, Hell, Leech, Mania, Inter Arma and much more.

metas.name: A Winter Tale at Shimla
metas.description: A Mature Sensible Love Story Where A Man Meets His Long Lost Love After Two Decades .The rekindled affair could be ruinous, for the jealous husband who is a DIG Police Officer, a brute with a unenviable reputation.

metas.name: A World Record Christmas
metas.description: Marissa and Eric encourage their young son with autism, who is determined to set a Guinness World Record — and has the chance to do so on Christmas Eve.

metas.name: A Young Time Ago
metas.description: When a man tells a beautiful stranger his young-love-gone-sour story, fate plays a hand in this tale of dreams, friend zones, revenge, hope and redemption

metas.name: Aankh Micholi
metas.description: A quirky Punjabi family hides its secrets to arrange their daughter's marriage to an NRI, but the prospective groom has a secret of his own.

metas.name: Aazam
metas.description: Aazam is a Hindi feature film, set in the underbelly of the Mumbai underworld, the story revolves around the succession battle of mafia don Nawab Khan, who is suffering from blood cancer and has only 10-15 days to live. Huh. Nawab Khan controls the syndicate of 5 partners in governing the city. Kadar - Nawab's son, is his legitimate heir in business, but on the advice of his colleague Javed, Kader plans to eliminate all his father's associates. Kadar's plan fails as other syndicate members have their own agenda for the gang war. DCP Joshi, who is trying to stop this gang war havoc, also gets caught in the conspiracy hatched by Javed. Who is the "Aazam" of this battle of defeat and victory?

metas.name: Ab Dilli Dur Nahin
metas.description: Abhay Shukla, a boy from a small town in Bihar reaches Delhi in the desire of success. Abhay comes from a family that is struggling with difficulties. Abhay aims to appear in the IAS exam and achieve success.

metas.name: Abang Adik
metas.description: Abang and Adi are undocumented orphans living in present-day Malaysia. While the older brother, a deaf mute, has resigned himself to a life of poverty, his younger sibling burns with indignation. A brutal accident upsets the fragile balance of their relationship.

metas.name: Abar Bibaho Obhijaan
metas.description: On being released from jails, Bullet Singh meets Anupam and Rajat to inform him that a fellow prisoner has gifted him a Rs. 100 crores worth Hotel, which he wants to share with them. They soon realize it's a trap. Can they get out of it?

metas.name: Abducted By My Teacher The Elizabeth Thomas Story
metas.description: The story of Elizabeth Thomas, a 15-year-old high school student who was groomed and abducted by teacher Tad Cummins.

metas.name: Abigail
metas.description: In 1976, a troubled teen befriends her bullied neighbor, seeking revenge on his tormentors, but her obsession turns deadly.

metas.name: About Dry Grasses
metas.description: A young art teacher hopes to be transferred to Istanbul after completing his mandatory duty in a remote village school in Anatolia. After accusations of inappropriate contact with a student surface, his hopes of escape fade and he descends further into an existential crisis.

metas.name: Abruptio
metas.description: Les Hackel is a guy down on his luck who wakes to find an explosive device has been implanted in his neck. He must carry out heinous crimes in order to stay alive while trying to identify the mastermind manipulating the now twisted and strange world around him.

metas.name: Accidental Texan
metas.description: Erwin blows his first acting job and finds himself stranded in Texas, where he's taken under the wing of a nearly bankrupt oil driller Merle and his cohort Faye. The three set off on a wild adventure to outwit the bank and a corrupt oil company to hit pay dirt before Merle's dreams are foreclosed.

metas.name: Accused
metas.description: After a revenge obsessed society incorrectly selects its next target, a young man must survive the night as the online witch-hunt arrives at his front door.

metas.name: Acid
metas.description: During a heat wave, strange clouds start pouring down acid rain, wreaking devastation and panic throughout France. In a world teetering on the edge, a girl and her divorced parents must join forces to confront and try to escape this climate catastrophe.

metas.name: Across The Furious Sea
metas.description: A murder case reveals unknown secrets of the killer and the victim.

metas.name: Adam Sandler The Kennedy Center Mark Twain Prize For American Humor
metas.description: Folder: Hollywood

metas.name: Adipurush
metas.description: 7000 years ago, Ayodhya's Prince Raghava and Prince Sesh along with the Mighty Vanar Warriors travels to the island of Lanka with an aim to rescue Raghava's wife Janaki, who has been abducted by Lankesh, the king of Lanka.

metas.name: Adipurush
metas.description: 7000 years ago, Ayodhya's Prince Raghava and Prince Sesh along with the Mighty Vanar Warriors travels to the island of Lanka with an aim to rescue Raghava's wife Janaki, who has been abducted by Lankesh, the king of Lanka.

metas.name: Adire
metas.description: A retired sex worker on the run, moves to a small town and starts a lingerie-making business (made from her signature adire material) which inevitably empowers the conservative women. Only to anger the self instilled leader, the deaconess and wife to the preacher of the town's local church. She soon discovers the most unusual friendships and love in the unlikeliest of places. Her paradise is cut short by Captain, her former pimp whose money she stole to start a new life.

metas.name: Adiyae
metas.description: Jeeva, a grieving youngster, who is on the verge of taking his life, finds new hope when he listens to his school-time crush Senthazhini’s song on TV. But Post a fatal accident, things take a turn for the worse when he accidentally enters an alternate reality.

metas.name: Advent
metas.description: A famed writer comes home to an Irish castle to complete his long overdue second novel, but is plagued by a rogues' gallery of local villagers who refuse to leave him alone. As time passes and he struggles to finish his book, their intrusions become increasingly disruptive and eventually, more sinister.

metas.name: Afire
metas.description: Self-important author Leon joins his best friend on a summer holiday near the Baltic Sea to complete his novel. When they arrive, they find their house is already occupied by a carefree woman who challenges Leon to open up. Meanwhile, forest wildfires rage around them and impending disaster looms.

metas.name: After Death
metas.description: Based on real near-death experiences, the afterlife is explored with the guidance of New York Times bestselling authors, medical experts, scientists and survivors who shed a light on what awaits us.

metas.name: Afwaah
metas.description: A woman seeks to escape her engagement to a violent politician, but when a stranger comes to her aid, the two face an onslaught of bigotry and hate.

metas.name: Against All Enemies
metas.description: Over one thousand people have been charged with storming the United States Capitol on January 6, 2021, as part of a widely televised insurrection attempt. Approximately 15% of them worked as police or military personnel. This staggering statistic begs an important question: how can a service member who took an oath to protect the country’s democracy do something that puts that very democracy in jeopardy?

metas.name: Agent
metas.description: Conman Robert Freegard poses as an undercover MI5 agent and kidnaps countless victims amidst a high-stakes manhunt, until the woman who fell for him brings him to justice.

metas.name: Aggro Dr1ft
metas.description: In the seedy domain of Miami’s criminal underbelly, a seasoned hitman embarks on the relentless pursuit of his next target. As shot entirely through thermal lens, he navigates a twisted world where violence and madness reign supreme. Tensions unravel, leading to a psychedelic journey that blurs the lines between predator and prey.

metas.name: Agilan
metas.description: Crane operator Agilan does all illegal activities in the harbour. Gokul is appointed to stop all these illegal activities. He brings in all the modern amenities to stop all these illegal activities. Agilan is capable of overcoming all the equipment and technology and continues with his activities. Gokul arrests Agilan to find the reason for all these activities.

metas.name: Agra
metas.description: The story of a family and an exploration of space in an increasingly crowded world. It follows the quest for a sexual odyssey of an individual.

metas.name: Air
metas.description: Discover the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

metas.name: Ajab Gajab Dhamal
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Ajmer 92
metas.description: Based on true events, Ajmer 92 tells the story of the grim plight of as many as 250 girls who were trapped, sexually exploited and blackmailed for years by caretakers of Ajmer Dargah, including many influential men in the area and Indian National Congress leaders in the city of Ajmer in Rajasthan in 1992.

metas.name: AKA
metas.description: A steely special ops agent finds his morality put to the test when he infiltrates a crime syndicate and unexpectedly bonds with the boss' young son.

metas.name: Akelli
metas.description: An Indian woman fights to survive in war-torn Iraq.

metas.name: Akhanda
metas.description: Brothers Murali Krishna and Akhanda are separated at birth. They grow up to lead completely separate lives, Murali as a local hero, and Akhanda as a secluded Shiva devotee. But when the lives of Murali and his family are in danger, his long-lost brother finally returns.

metas.name: Ala Ninnu Cheri
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Albert Brooks Defending My Life
metas.description: Rob Reiner profiles Albert Brooks, comedic legend, acclaimed filmmaker, talented character actor and a lifelong friend, who Reiner first met in their high school drama club.

metas.name: Alien Intervention
metas.description: A woman's purpose is redefined when a space alien she encountered as a child returns to reclaim what was left behind.

metas.name: All Dirt Roads Taste Of Salt
metas.description: Tender caresses and enveloping embraces are portals into the life of Mack, a Black woman in Mississippi. Winding through the anticipation, love, and heartbreak she experiences from childhood to adulthood, the expressionist journey is an ode to connection — with loved ones and with place.

metas.name: All I Want Is You
metas.description: After holding down her man during his 4-year-long prison sentence, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal him away.

metas.name: All India Rank
metas.description: Set in the 90s, seventeen-year-old Vivek is sent away from home to attend a rigorous program to prepare for the highly competitive IIT entrance exams. Over two years, Vivek goes through the motions of Indian adolescence, but it is his parents who do the growing up.

metas.name: All Of Those Voices
metas.description: Ditching the typical glossy sheen of celebrity documentaries, this film gives audiences an intimate and unvarnished view of Louis Tomlinson's life and career. Through never-before-seen home movie footage and behind the scenes access to Louis’ sell-out 2022 World Tour, the documentary offers a unique perspective on what it's like to be a musician in today's fast-paced world.

metas.name: All Of Us Strangers
metas.description: One night in his near-empty tower block in contemporary London, Adam has a chance encounter with a mysterious neighbor, which punctures the rhythm of his everyday life.

metas.name: All The Colours Of The World Are Between Black And White
metas.description: Bambino and Bawa meet in Lagos and hit it off immediately. During their long trips around the city they develop a deep affection for each other. But in a society which considers homosexuality taboo, they feel the pressure of social norms.

metas.name: All You Need Is Blood
metas.description: Bucky is a 16-year-old aspiring director who dreams of becoming the next arthouse auteur sensation. After a strange meteor crash lands in his backyard and turns his deadbeat father into a brain-eating zombie, Bucky and his friends seize the opportunity to create the ultimate horror flick, starring his undead dad.

metas.name: All You Need Is Death
metas.description: A young couple who collect rare folk ballads discover the dark side of love when they surreptitiously record and translate an ancient, taboo folk song from the deep, forgotten past.

metas.name: Almost Pyaar With DJ Mohabbat
metas.description: In pursuit of forbidden love, two young couples from different worlds find their lives entangled as rebellion and intolerance collide in dual stories.

metas.name: Alone
metas.description: Kevin McCallister's parents have split up. Now living with his mom, he decides to spend Christmas with his dad at the mansion of his father's rich girlfriend, Natalie. Meanwhile robber Marv Merchants, one of the villains from the first two movies, partners up with a new criminal named Vera to hit Natalie's mansion.

metas.name: Amala
metas.description: The journey of a brilliant police officer who is entrusted with the task of solving a series of murders happening in the city overnight. He sets out to find clues that would lead him to the killer.

metas.name: Amazon Music Live Wu Tang Clan Nas And De La Souls N Y State Of Mind Tour
metas.description: Folder: Hollywood

metas.name: American Fiction
metas.description: A novelist fed up with the establishment profiting from "Black" entertainment uses a pen name to write a book that propels him into the heart of hypocrisy and the madness he claims to disdain.

metas.name: American Girl
metas.description: When her mother gets sick, 13-year-old Fen moves back to Taiwan, where she struggles to fit in amid the 2003 SARS epidemic.

metas.name: American Meltdown
metas.description: When a Millennial woman finds herself unable to pay rent, she befriends a small-time con artist who encourages her to chart her own path - by embracing petty crime.

metas.name: American Symphony
metas.description: Musician Jon Batiste attempts to compose a symphony as his wife, writer Suleika Jaouad, undergoes cancer treatment.

metas.name: Amigos
metas.description: A trio of unemployed silent film actors are mistaken for real heroes by a small Mexican village in search of someone to stop a malevolent bandit.

metas.name: An Ice Palace Romance
metas.description: A journalist faces old fears when she returns to her hometown ice rink to cover a story. With the help of the owner and his young daughter, she begins to reevaluate her life's purpose.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

metas.name: Andy Huggins Early Bird Special
metas.description: Comedian Andy Huggins performs a live stand-up special in Houston, Texas.

metas.name: Aneethi
metas.description: A food delivery guy with a medical condition falls in love with Subbu, a housekeeper, whom he believes to be his world. However, trouble begins, when both get entangled in a case involving the death of an elderly woman.

metas.name: Angshuman MBA
metas.description: Friends often mock ‘Angshuman’ about the family business. So he will do something new with a master’s degree in commerce. He also started a break-up company accordingly! This organization helps to end the long-running conflict between boyfriend and girlfriend or husband and wife. That is, it causes separation!

metas.name: Animal
metas.description: The hardened son of a powerful industrialist returns home after years abroad and vows to take bloody revenge on those threatening his father's life.

metas.name: Anjelah Johnson Reyes Say I Wont
metas.description: Filmed at the historic Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, Anjelah Johnson-Reyes is back in a new hilarious stand up routine.

metas.name: Annapoorani
metas.description: A young girl from a conservative family aspires to become the best cook in India.

metas.name: Anni Manchi Sakunamule
metas.description: Set in a fictional place called Victoriapuram, a feud between two families for a coffee estate have been going on for three generations. Unforeseen romance between two contrasting personalities from these families changes all their lives forever.

metas.name: Another Body
metas.description: A college student searches for justice after she discovers deepfake pornography of herself circulating online.

metas.name: Ant Man and the Wasp Quantumania
metas.description: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.

metas.name: Anthony Is Dead The Funeral Roast
metas.description: Smosh reawakens their breakout series [Blank] is Dead: The Funeral Roast for a night to DIE for! Anthony Padilla will Roast in Peace, and all of your favorite Smosh friends will be at his "Funeral" to make it so. With a musical halftime show, YouTuber guests, and the ability to submit your OWN roasts, this will be the WILDEST live show that you may ever attend!

metas.name: Antikalpa
metas.description: Ah Dai comes from a family that runs a prestigious orthodox temple. His childhood sweetheart, Yufan, is desperate to locate her missing aunt. In his attempt to help, Ah Dai agrees to participate in a special ritual that his schoolmates believe could help them seek assistance from the gods to grant their desires. However, they are lured into praying to evil forces instead. As his schoolmates die one after another, Ah Dai tries to use his gift to exorcise evil to save his friends. At the very end, he faces a completely demonized Yufan and must fight her to save the neighborhood.

metas.name: Antony
metas.description: Antony is a ruthless gangster in a town and has a close-knit group, which includes Ann Maria, a college student trained in MMA. Maria and Antony soon get into trouble due to unforeseen circumstances and they set out to solve the issues in violent ways

metas.name: Anu
metas.description: From local filmmaker Sudeshna Sen comes this touching coming-of-age story about a South Asian-American 12-year-old who believes her recently passed grandfather may be coming back as the holy reincarnation of Siddhartha.

metas.name: Anuragam
metas.description: She baked some love.

metas.name: Anyone But You
metas.description: After an amazing first date, Bea and Ben’s fiery attraction turns ice cold — until they find themselves unexpectedly reunited at a destination wedding in Australia. So they do what any two mature adults would do: pretend to be a couple.

metas.name: Apocalypse Clown
metas.description: When a mysterious technological blackout plunges Ireland into anarchy and chaos, a group of failed, washed-up clowns are forced to traverse the country for one last shot at their dreams.

metas.name: Apocalypse Evil
metas.description: A mother and daughter face a new stage in their lives. One night the mother goes to dinner with friends, leaving her daughter home alone. From that moment on their lives take an unexpected turn due to the terrible results of their actions.

metas.name: Aporia
metas.description: Since losing her husband, Sophie has struggled to manage grief, a full-time job, and parenting her devastated daughter, but when a former physicist reveals a secret time-bending machine, Sophie will be faced with an impossible choice.

metas.name: Appendage
metas.description: After hitting a breaking point, Hannah's inner thoughts physicalize into a monstrous creature that threatens to upend her life.

metas.name: Apurva
metas.description: In the merciless Chambal ravines, a regular girl must outwit hardcore dacoits to survive one night before any help comes her way.

metas.name: Aquaman And The Lost Kingdom
metas.description: Black Manta seeks revenge on Aquaman for his father's death. Wielding the Black Trident's power, he becomes a formidable foe. To defend Atlantis, Arthur (Aquaman) forges an alliance with his imprisoned brother. They must protect the kingdom.

metas.name: Archier Gallery
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Ardhangini
metas.description: After Suman suffers an accident, the two women in his life - Meghna, the wife, and Shubhra, the ex-wife - are compelled to meet each other. Ardhangini revolves around the awkward emotional duel between the two wives - past and present - in a time of personal crisis.
